newsitem.title: USA: T-NETIX sees EPS hurt until later this yr.
newsitem.headline: T-NETIX sees EPS hurt until later this yr.

text.p: T-NETIX Inc said on Thursday that its heavy investment in developing and marketing SpeakEZ Voice Print products will have a negative impact on earnings until those products begin to generate revenues.
Revenues from SpeakEZ products should begin later in the third and fourth quarters of the year, Chief Financial Officer Alvyn Schopp said.
T-NETIX provides call processing services to the telecommunications industry.
On Thursday the company reported a first quarter loss of $0.04 per share, compared to $0.07 per share profit in the year-ago quarter. The quarter ended October 31.
